text:
The factual content is correct. The tropical year is about 365.2422 days, the Gregorian rules are right, the 400-year overcorrection of roughly 3 days is accurate, and the 1900 and 2000 examples are explained properly. The reasoning is clear and covers the key points: the drift that motivates leap years, why the simple every-four-years rule overcorrects, and why the century exception exists.

The main problem is the explicit constraint of "under 120 words." The response runs to roughly 200 words, so it fails a stated requirement. Some sentences are also filler, such as "Put another way, the difference is not zero" and "It is worth looking at why...", which add length without adding content. A compliant answer could have covered the same key points in about half the space.

Score: 4
